deskyard browser connect: forward the computer's browser to a local CDP port

Usage: deskyard [-c COMPUTER] browser connect [--port N]

Listens on 127.0.0.1:PORT and forwards the Chrome DevTools Protocol to the
computer's shared Chromium (the one on its desktop, with your signed-in
sessions), so Playwright, Puppeteer or DevTools tools connect as if the
browser were local. Prints the URL, then keeps running until Ctrl-C. Run it in
the background. Inside a computer it isn't needed: CDP is at
http://127.0.0.1:9221.

Options:
  --port N             local port (0 = any free port) (default 9222)

Prints: first line: the local CDP URL (http://127.0.0.1:9222); connection log
  on stderr

Examples:
  deskyard -c alice browser connect &
  # then in Python: p.chromium.connect_over_cdp("http://127.0.0.1:9222")

Where: on the chosen computer (-c COMPUTER); inside a computer without one chosen it acts locally
Exit codes: 0 ok, 1 error, 2 usage error
